title: WHY RED PANDAS LIVE HIGH IN THE TREES
caption: Why do red pandas love the treetops? 🐾🌿 #RedPanda #Wildlife #AnimalBehavior #NatureFacts #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: Why does this red panda spend so much time balancing high in the branches?
narration_timeline.scene: Red panda moving on a high branch, not a fake hand-like paw close-up.

narration_timeline.text: Up here, it can reach the bamboo that makes up much of its diet.
narration_timeline.scene: Red panda clearly eating bamboo among branches.

narration_timeline.text: Watch its paws grip the bark as it moves along the branches.
narration_timeline.scene: Red panda showing paws on branch, walking or repositioning on bark.

narration_timeline.text: Sharp claws help it cling to the wood, even when the path looks narrow.
narration_timeline.scene: Real red panda gripping or moving across branches, no anatomical claims not visible.

narration_timeline.text: Between meals, a thick branch also makes a surprisingly comfortable resting spot.
narration_timeline.scene: Red panda perched or resting in tree between feeding sessions.

narration_timeline.text: So these trees are more than a climbing frame. They're a pantry, a pathway, and a place to rest.
narration_timeline.scene: Close red panda feeding shot resolves tree-as-pantry narrative.
